description: Source script for initializing and configuring a Supabase project, including project creation, waiting for readiness, linking, database setup, fetching API keys, and saving environment variables.

methods.name: loginToSupabase
methods.description: Logs into Supabase CLI using npx command.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new Supabase project with specified name and database password; returns the project ID.

methods.name: waitForProjectToBeReady
methods.description: Polls the project list until the project status is 'ACTIVE_HEALTHY'.

methods.name: linkProject
methods.description: Links a local project to an existing Supabase project reference, with retry upon failure.

methods.name: setupDatabase
methods.description: Pushes local database schema to the linked Supabase database.

methods.name: fetchApiKeys
methods.description: Retrieves API keys for the project, specifically the 'anon' key, with retries if not immediately available.

methods.name: persistSupabaseEnv
methods.description: Writes environment variables for Supabase project URL and anon key into a local .env file.

methods.name: generatePassword
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random password of specified length.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.
